queues.strategy: Add independent source-complete crypto distribution/markdown episodes using the same core derivatives evidence class. Prefer existing Coinbase/Binance/FRED/meaning adapters before adding new providers.
Add distinct non-overlapping liquidity/volatility shock episodes with cross-asset stress sensors and explicit event-time information.
Add independent housing cycles/countries with price index, financing/rates, activity and publication-lag evidence.
Expand only where historical OI/long-short/taker positioning is truly available; never upgrade CORE samples synthetically.

rules: One independent episode contributes at most one sample per horizon/cohort.
Overlapping duplicate windows are grouped and deduplicated.
Coverage and horizon profiles may not be silently mixed.
